<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Kacang Shanghai Nusa Jaya – Renyah, Gurih, Kualitas Terbaik</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@700;900&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root {
  --green-dark: #1a4a2e;
  --green-mid: #2d6a45;
  --green-light: #3d8b5a;
  --gold: #d4a017;
  --gold-light: #f0c040;
  --cream: #fdf6e3;
  --cream-dark: #f5e8c0;
  --white: #ffffff;
  --text-dark: #1a2e1a;
  --wa: #25D366;
}
* { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior:smooth; }
body { font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif; background:var(--cream); color:var(--text-dark); overflow-x:hidden; }

/* NAV */
nav {
  position:fixed; top:0; left:0; right:0; z-index:999;
  background:rgba(26,74,46,0.97); backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  padding:0 5%; height:68px;
  box-shadow:0 2px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
}
.nav-logo { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; text-decoration:none; }
.nav-logo-badge {
  background:var(--gold); color:var(--green-dark);
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif; font-weight:900; font-size:1.1rem;
  padding:4px 12px; border-radius:4px; line-height:1.2; text-align:center;
}
.nav-logo-badge span { display:block; font-size:0.6rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:2px; text-transform:uppercase; }
.nav-links { display:flex; gap:28px; list-style:none; }
.nav-links a { color:rgba(255,255,255,0.85); text-decoration:none; font-size:0.88rem; font-weight:500; transition:color .2s; }
.nav-links a:hover { color:var(--gold-light); }
.nav-wa {
  background:var(--wa); color:#fff; padding:9px 20px; border-radius:30px;
  text-decoration:none; font-weight:700; font-size:0.85rem;
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px;
  transition:transform .2s, box-shadow .2s;
  box-shadow:0 4px 15px rgba(37,211,102,0.4);
}
.nav-wa:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(37,211,102,0.5); }
.hamburger { display:none; flex-direction:column; gap:5px; cursor:pointer; padding:5px; }
.hamburger span { width:24px; height:2px; background:#fff; border-radius:2px; transition:all .3s; }
.mobile-menu {
  display:none; position:fixed; top:68px; left:0; right:0;
  background:var(--green-dark); padding:20px 5%; z-index:998;
  flex-direction:column; gap:16px;
}
.mobile-menu a { color:rgba(255,255,255,0.9); text-decoration:none; font-size:1rem; font-weight:500; padding:8px 0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }
.mobile-menu.open { display:flex; }

/* HERO */
#beranda {
  min-height:100vh;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--green-dark) 0%, var(--green-mid) 60%, #1f5c36 100%);
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  align-items:center; padding:100px 7% 60px; gap:40px;
  position:relative; overflow:hidden;
}
#beranda::before {
  content:''; position:absolute; inset:0;
  background:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' viewBox='0 0 60 60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' fill-rule='evenodd'%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='0.03'%3E%3Ccircle cx='30' cy='30' r='4'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E");
}
.hero-text { position:relative; z-index:2; }
.hero-tag {
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  background:rgba(212,160,23,0.2); border:1px solid var(--gold); color:var(--gold-light);
  padding:6px 16px; border-radius:30px;
  font-size:0.78rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:2px; text-transform:uppercase;
  margin-bottom:20px;
}
.hero-tag::before { content:'✦'; }
.hero-title {
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-size:clamp(2.8rem,6vw,5rem); font-weight:900; color:#fff;
  line-height:1.05; margin-bottom:12px;
}
.hero-title span { color:var(--gold-light); }
.hero-sub { font-size:1rem; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.75); margin-bottom:28px; line-height:1.7; max-width:460px; }
.hero-pills { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; margin-bottom:36px; }
.hero-pill {
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:#fff;
  padding:6px 16px; border-radius:30px; font-size:0.82rem; font-weight:600;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
}
.hero-btns { display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.btn-wa {
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  background:var(--wa); color:#fff; padding:14px 28px; border-radius:40px;
  text-decoration:none; font-weight:700; font-size:0.95rem;
  box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(37,211,102,0.45); transition:all .25s; border:none; cursor:pointer;
}
.btn-wa:hover { transform:translateY(-3px); box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(37,211,102,0.55); }
.btn-outline {
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  background:transparent; color:#fff; padding:14px 28px; border-radius:40px;
  text-decoration:none; font-weight:700; font-size:0.95rem;
  border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5); transition:all .25s; cursor:pointer;
}
.btn-outline:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-color:#fff; }
.hero-img { position:relative; z-index:2; display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; }
.hero-packshot-wrap {
  position:relative; animation:float 4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes float { 0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)} 50%{transform:translateY(-14px)} }
.hero-packshot-wrap img {
  width:100%; max-width:380px; border-radius:20px;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.55));
}
.badge-kualitas {
  position:absolute; top:-14px; right:-14px;
  background:var(--gold); color:var(--green-dark);
  width:96px; height:96px; border-radius:50%;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  font-weight:900; font-size:0.68rem; text-align:center; line-height:1.3;
  text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.5px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 25px rgba(212,160,23,0.5);
  animation:spin-slow 12s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes spin-slow { from{transform:rotate(0)} to{transform:rotate(360deg)} }

/* LIFESTYLE BANNER */
.lifestyle-banner {
  background:var(--green-dark);
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  align-items:stretch; overflow:hidden;
  min-height:380px;
}
.lifestyle-img-wrap { position:relative; overflow:hidden; }
.lifestyle-img-wrap img {
  width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; object-position:center top;
  display:block;
  transition:transform .6s ease;
}
.lifestyle-img-wrap:hover img { transform:scale(1.04); }
.lifestyle-text {
  padding:50px 7% 50px 5%;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; gap:16px;
}
.lifestyle-text .section-label { text-align:left; color:var(--gold-light); }
.lifestyle-text h2 {
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.5vw,2.6rem); font-weight:700; color:#fff;
  line-height:1.2;
}
.lifestyle-text p { color:rgba(255,255,255,0.75); font-size:0.95rem; line-height:1.7; }

/* KEUNGGULAN */
#keunggulan { background:#fff; padding:70px 7%; }
.section-label {
  text-align:center; color:var(--green-mid);
  font-size:0.78rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:3px; text-transform:uppercase;
  margin-bottom:10px;
}
.section-title {
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.6rem); font-weight:700;
  text-align:center; color:var(--green-dark); margin-bottom:50px;
}
.features-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:24px; }
.feature-card {
  background:var(--cream); border-radius:16px; padding:28px 22px; text-align:center;
  border:1px solid rgba(212,160,23,0.2); transition:all .3s;
}
.feature-card:hover { transform:translateY(-6px); box-shadow:0 15px 40px rgba(45,106,69,0.15); border-color:var(--gold); }
.feature-icon {
  width:60px; height:60px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--green-dark),var(--green-light));
  border-radius:16px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  font-size:1.6rem; margin:0 auto 16px;
}
.feature-card h3 { color:var(--green-dark); font-size:1rem; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:8px; }
.feature-card p { color:#666; font-size:0.85rem; line-height:1.6; }

/* PRODUK */
#produk { background:var(--cream); padding:70px 7%; }
.products-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr) 1.1fr; gap:24px; align-items:start; }
.product-card {
  background:#fff; border-radius:20px; overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid rgba(212,160,23,0.15); transition:all .3s;
  box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
}
.product-card:hover { transform:translateY(-8px); box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(45,106,69,0.18); }
.product-img {
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e8f5ec,var(--cream-dark));
  padding:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  height:220px; overflow:hidden; position:relative;
}
.product-img img {
  width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; object-position:center;
  transition:transform .5s ease;
}
.product-card:hover .product-img img { transform:scale(1.07); }
.product-info { padding:20px; }
.product-info h3 { font-size:1rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--green-dark); margin-bottom:6px; }
.product-info p { font-size:0.82rem; color:#777; margin-bottom:16px; line-height:1.5; }
.product-info .btn-wa { padding:11px 20px; font-size:0.85rem; width:100%; justify-content:center; }
.product-halal-badge {
  position:absolute; top:10px; right:10px;
  background:var(--green-dark); color:var(--gold-light);
  font-size:0.68rem; font-weight:700; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:20px;
  text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:1px;
}
.reseller-card {
  background:var(--green-dark); border-radius:20px; padding:30px 24px;
  color:#fff; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px;
}
.reseller-card h3 { font-family:'Playfair Display',serif; font-size:1.4rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--gold-light); line-height:1.3; }
.reseller-list { list-style:none; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; }
.reseller-list li {
  display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px;
  font-size:0.88rem; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.88); line-height:1.5;
}
.reseller-list li::before { content:'✓'; color:var(--gold-light); font-weight:900; flex-shrink:0; margin-top:1px; }
.reseller-card .btn-wa { justify-content:center; margin-top:auto; }

/* GROSIR SECTION */
.grosir-section {
  background:#fff; padding:70px 7%;
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:60px; align-items:center;
}
.grosir-img-wrap { position:relative; }
.grosir-img-wrap img {
  width:100%; border-radius:24px;
  box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(26,74,46,0.25);
  display:block;
}
.grosir-img-overlay {
  position:absolute; bottom:-20px; right:-20px;
  background:var(--gold); color:var(--green-dark);
  padding:16px 22px; border-radius:16px;
  font-weight:700; font-size:0.9rem; line-height:1.4;
  box-shadow:0 8px 25px rgba(212,160,23,0.4);
}
.grosir-text .section-label { text-align:left; }
.grosir-text .section-title { text-align:left; margin-bottom:20px; }
.grosir-text p { color:#555; font-size:0.95rem; line-height:1.7; margin-bottom:24px; }
.grosir-stats { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:16px; margin-bottom:28px; }
.grosir-stat {
  background:var(--cream); border-radius:14px; padding:16px;
  border:1px solid rgba(212,160,23,0.2); text-align:center;
}
.grosir-stat strong { display:block; font-size:1.6rem; font-weight:900; color:var(--green-dark); }
.grosir-stat span { font-size:0.78rem; color:#777; font-weight:600; }

/* KENAPA */
#tentang {
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--green-dark),var(--green-mid));
  padding:80px 7%; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:60px; align-items:center;
}
.why-text .section-label { text-align:left; color:var(--gold-light); }
.why-text .section-title { text-align:left; color:#fff; margin-bottom:28px; }
.why-list { list-style:none; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px; }
.why-list li {
  display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:14px;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,0.9); font-size:0.95rem; line-height:1.6;
}
.why-icon {
  width:36px; height:36px; background:var(--gold); border-radius:10px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:1rem; flex-shrink:0;
}
.why-img-real {
  border-radius:24px; overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  position:relative;
}
.why-img-real img { width:100%; display:block; }
.why-img-real .overlay-badge {
  position:absolute; bottom:20px; left:20px; right:20px;
  background:rgba(26,74,46,0.92); backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  border-radius:12px; padding:14px 18px; color:#fff;
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  border:1px solid rgba(212,160,23,0.3);
}
.why-img-real .overlay-badge .badge-icon { font-size:1.5rem; }
.why-img-real .overlay-badge strong { display:block; color:var(--gold-light); font-size:0.82rem; }
.why-img-real .overlay-badge span { font-size:0.78rem; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.75); }

/* KEMITRAAN */
#kemitraan { background:var(--cream); padding:70px 7%; }
.mitra-top {
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr; gap:40px;
  align-items:center; margin-bottom:50px;
  background:var(--green-dark); border-radius:28px; overflow:hidden;
}
.mitra-flyer-img { height:420px; overflow:hidden; }
.mitra-flyer-img img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; object-position:top; }
.mitra-top-text { padding:40px 40px 40px 0; color:#fff; }
.mitra-top-text h2 {
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-size:clamp(1.6rem,3vw,2.2rem); font-weight:700; color:var(--gold-light);
  margin-bottom:16px; line-height:1.3;
}
.mitra-top-text p { color:rgba(255,255,255,0.8); font-size:0.9rem; line-height:1.7; margin-bottom:20px; }
.mitra-top-list { list-style:none; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; margin-bottom:24px; }
.mitra-top-list li {
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,0.9); font-size:0.88rem;
}
.mitra-top-list li::before { content:'✓'; color:var(--gold-light); font-weight:900; }
.mitra-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:24px; }
.mitra-card {
  background:#fff; border-radius:18px; padding:30px 24px; text-align:center;
  border:1px solid rgba(212,160,23,0.2); transition:all .3s;
}
.mitra-card:hover { transform:translateY(-6px); box-shadow:0 15px 35px rgba(45,106,69,0.12); }
.mitra-icon { font-size:2.5rem; margin-bottom:16px; }
.mitra-card h3 { font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--green-dark); margin-bottom:10px; }
.mitra-card p { font-size:0.85rem; color:#666; line-height:1.6; margin-bottom:18px; }
.btn-mitra {
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  background:var(--green-dark); color:#fff; padding:10px 22px; border-radius:30px;
  text-decoration:none; font-weight:700; font-size:0.85rem;
  transition:all .25s; border:none; cursor:pointer;
}
.btn-mitra:hover { background:var(--green-light); transform:translateY(-2px); }

/* TESTIMONI */
#testimoni { background:#fff; padding:70px 7%; }
.testi-hero {
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 2fr; gap:40px;
  align-items:center; margin-bottom:50px;
}
.testi-hero-img { border-radius:24px; overflow:hidden; box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(26,74,46,0.2); }
.testi-hero-img img { width:100%; display:block; }
.testi-hero-text h2 {
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-size:clamp(1.6rem,3vw,2.2rem); font-weight:700; color:var(--green-dark);
  margin-bottom:12px;
}
.testi-hero-text p { color:#555; font-size:0.95rem; line-height:1.7; margin-bottom:20px; }
.testi-hero-numbers { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:16px; }
.testi-num {
  background:var(--cream); border-radius:14px; padding:16px; text-align:center;
  border:1px solid rgba(212,160,23,0.2);
}
.testi-num strong { display:block; font-size:1.8rem; font-weight:900; color:var(--green-dark); }
.testi-num span { font-size:0.75rem; color:#777; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.5px; }
.testi-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:24px; }
.testi-card {
  background:var(--cream); border-radius:18px; padding:28px;
  border:1px solid rgba(212,160,23,0.15); position:relative;
}
.testi-card::before {
  content:'"'; position:absolute; top:16px; right:24px;
  font-size:4rem; color:rgba(212,160,23,0.2); font-family:Georgia,serif; line-height:1;
}
.testi-stars { color:var(--gold); font-size:1rem; margin-bottom:12px; }
.testi-card p { font-size:0.9rem; line-height:1.7; color:#555; margin-bottom:18px; }
.testi-author { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; }
.testi-avatar {
  width:42px; height:42px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--green-dark),var(--green-light));
  border-radius:50%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  color:#fff; font-weight:700; font-size:1rem;
}
.testi-name { font-weight:700; font-size:0.9rem; color:var(--green-dark); }
.testi-loc { font-size:0.78rem; color:#999; }

/* KONTAK */
#kontak {
  background:var(--green-dark); padding:80px 7%;
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:60px; align-items:start;
}
.kontak-info h2 {
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.5vw,2.4rem); font-weight:700; color:#fff; margin-bottom:8px;
}
.kontak-info .sub { color:rgba(255,255,255,0.7); margin-bottom:36px; font-size:0.95rem; line-height:1.6; }
.kontak-items { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:20px; }
.kontak-item { display:flex; gap:16px; align-items:flex-start; }
.kontak-item-icon {
  width:44px; height:44px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius:12px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:1.2rem; flex-shrink:0;
}
.kontak-item-text strong {
  display:block; color:var(--gold-light); font-size:0.82rem;
  font-weight:700; letter-spacing:1px; text-transform:uppercase; margin-bottom:4px;
}
.kontak-item-text span { color:rgba(255,255,255,0.85); font-size:0.9rem; line-height:1.6; }
.kontak-item-text a { color:rgba(255,255,255,0.85); text-decoration:none; }
.kontak-item-text a:hover { color:var(--gold-light); }
.kontak-form-wrap {
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius:20px; padding:36px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
}
.kontak-form-wrap h3 { font-size:1.2rem; font-weight:700; color:#fff; margin-bottom:24px; }
.form-group { margin-bottom:18px; }
.form-group label { display:block; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.7); font-size:0.82rem; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:6px; }
.form-group input, .form-group textarea, .form-group select {
  width:100%; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  border-radius:10px; padding:12px 16px; color:#fff;
  font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif; font-size:0.9rem; transition:border-color .2s; outline:none;
}
.form-group input::placeholder, .form-group textarea::placeholder { color:rgba(255,255,255,0.35); }
.form-group input:focus, .form-group textarea:focus, .form-group select:focus { border-color:var(--gold); }
.form-group textarea { resize:vertical; min-height:100px; }
.form-group select option { background:var(--green-dark); }
.btn-submit {
  width:100%; background:var(--wa); color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:12px;
  padding:14px; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px;
  transition:all .25s; box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(37,211,102,0.35);
}
.btn-submit:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(37,211,102,0.5); }

/* FOOTER */
footer {
  background:#0f2d1c; padding:28px 7%;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:16px;
}
footer p { color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5); font-size:0.82rem; }
.footer-wa {
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  background:var(--wa); color:#fff; padding:10px 22px; border-radius:30px;
  text-decoration:none; font-weight:700; font-size:0.88rem; transition:all .25s;
}
.footer-wa:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); }

/* FLOAT WA */
.wa-float {
  position:fixed; bottom:28px; right:28px; z-index:990;
  width:60px; height:60px; background:var(--wa); border-radius:50%;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  text-decoration:none; box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(37,211,102,0.5);
  animation:pulse 2.5s infinite; transition:transform .2s;
}
.wa-float:hover { transform:scale(1.1); }
@keyframes pulse { 0%,100%{box-shadow:0 6px 25px rgba(37,211,102,0.5)} 50%{box-shadow:0 6px 40px rgba(37,211,102,0.7)} }
.wa-float svg { width:32px; height:32px; }

/* SCROLL ANIM */
.reveal { opacity:0; transform:translateY(30px); transition:opacity .6s ease, transform .6s ease; }
.reveal.visible { opacity:1; transform:none; }

/* RESPONSIVE */
@media(max-width:900px){
  .nav-links { display:none; }
  .hamburger { display:flex; }
  #beranda { grid-template-columns:1fr; padding-top:88px; text-align:center; }
  .hero-text { order:2; }
  .hero-img { order:1; }
  .hero-sub { margin:0 auto 28px; }
  .hero-pills { justify-content:center; }
  .hero-btns { justify-content:center; }
  .lifestyle-banner { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .features-grid { grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); }
  .products-grid { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .grosir-section { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .grosir-img-overlay { right:10px; bottom:10px; }
  #tentang { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .mitra-top { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .mitra-flyer-img { height:280px; }
  .mitra-top-text { padding:30px; }
  .mitra-grid { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .testi-hero { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .testi-grid { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  #kontak { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  footer { flex-direction:column; text-align:center; }
}
@media(max-width:600px){
  .features-grid { grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; }
  .testi-hero-numbers { grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr; }
}
</style>

<script>
function toggleMenu() {
  document.getElementById('mobileMenu').classList.toggle('open');
}
document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  const menu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
  if (!e.target.closest('nav') && !e.target.closest('#mobileMenu')) menu.classList.remove('open');
});

const reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach((entry, i) => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting) setTimeout(() => entry.target.classList.add('visible'), i * 100);
  });
}, { threshold: 0.1 });
reveals.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

function kirimPesan() {
  const nama = document.getElementById('nama').value.trim();
  const wa = document.getElementById('wa_num').value.trim();
  const keperluan = document.getElementById('keperluan').value;
  const pesan = document.getElementById('pesan').value.trim();
  if (!nama) { alert('Mohon masukkan nama Anda.'); return; }
  if (!wa) { alert('Mohon masukkan nomor WhatsApp Anda.'); return; }
  const kLabel = {pemesanan:'Pemesanan Produk',reseller:'Daftar Reseller',grosir:'Grosir / Distributor',kerjasama:'Kerjasama Bisnis',lainnya:'Lainnya'};
  let msg = 'Halo Nusa Jaya! 👋\n\n';
  msg += '*Nama:* ' + nama + '\n';
  msg += '*No. WA:* ' + wa + '\n';
  if (keperluan) msg += '*Keperluan:* ' + (kLabel[keperluan] || keperluan) + '\n';
  if (pesan) msg += '*Pesan:* ' + pesan + '\n';
  msg += '\nTerima kasih!';
  window.open('https://wa.me/6285753807233?text=' + encodeURIComponent(msg), '_blank');
}

const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section[id]');
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  let current = '';
  sections.forEach(sec => { if (window.scrollY >= sec.offsetTop - 100) current = sec.id; });
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-links a').forEach(a => {
    a.style.color = a.getAttribute('href') === '#' + current ? 'var(--gold-light)' : '';
  });
});
</script>
